integrity: Universally quantified statements are proved analytically; finite exact verification supplements the proof. No independent review was conducted.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to four-input rule 56528 on finite cyclic rings. The 2026 motivating paper studies a distinct reversible rule, while the foundational 56528 local dynamics is prior published work from 2020. Historical priority for the complete exact periodic-point formulas has not been independently resolved.
title: Complete periodic-orbit and zeta classification for a blocking number-conserving cellular automaton
